newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares start easier, direction uncertain.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares start easier, direction uncertain.

text.p: 0830 GMT - Italian stocks got off to a slightly easier start after the long holiday weekend here in line with a lower close on Wall Street on Friday but with the market uncertain of a concrete direction, dealers said. Fiat performing well.

There was little reaction to initial forecasts of the outcome of Sunday's local elections, showing Italy's main opposition alliance leading in mayoral races in key cities of Milan and Turin after a first round that ended the separatist Northern League's control of Italy's business capital.
* All-share Mibtel index off 0.39 percent at 12,130
* Mib30 blue chip index down 0.39 percent at 18,050

"The Bourse isn't taking much notice of the polls," one dealer said, "although there's perhaps a slight worry about an increased vote share for the hard-left Communist Refoundation." But traders noted Btp bond futures and lira were firmer.

* Fiat was up 0.66 percent at 5,465 lire. The industrial giant on Thursday reported a 1996 net profit of 2.371 trillion lire against 1995's 2.147 trillion and said that in the first quarter of 1997 its pretax profit rose to 495 billion lire from 464 billion in the first quarter of 1996.
* Telecoms mixed, with Stet holding and mobile phone operator TIM a touch firmer but Telecom Italia off 0.39 percent at 4,350 lire. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
